card.name: The word example after "for"
card.fires_on: The word that completes an "for example" or "for instance" phrase, such as example, instance, say or particular. It usually comes after a comma and introduces an illustration.

modes.label: for example / for instance
modes.description: The closing word of "for example" or "for instance" that introduces a sample case.
modes.example: You can think of this as being the collective action necessary to avoid average global temperature rises of 2oC by 2050, for<< example>>.

modes.label: say or in particular
modes.description: Other illustrating or singling-out words, such as "say" or "in particular".

card.writes: It suppresses words like particularly and especially (also in Chinese and Japanese), so it steers away from emphasis words after an example phrase.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a writer says "for example" and is about to give a sample case.
